title: A clinically effective model based on cell-free DNA methylation and low-dose CT for risk stratification of pulmonary nodules.
summary: A model combines cell-free DNA methylation markers with low-dose CT and is evaluated in two multicenter pulmonary-nodule cohorts (n=620 and n=343); the paper reports comparative nodule-risk classification and potential decision impact.
ai_technology: Prospective multicenter validation cohorts and clinical/comparator models; findings are risk stratification, not proof of improved outcomes.
organization: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University
